question: Identify the ordinary Jacobian local Kummer condition in the torsion-difference sequence, and certify the local connecting ranks on rational two-torsion.
precision_rule: min(128, max(16, 4*v_p(disc(f))+16)); all returned root approximations must pass exact Hensel and local square-stability inequalities.
checkpoints: One immutable record per retained place under an isolated rank-jump directory.
failure_semantics: A failed root count, stability inequality, local membership or resource limit leaves the local condition uncertified. No CT entry or rational point is inferred from dimensions.
